title: Good King Hezekiah Trusts God
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart, and tonight Hezekiah bravely clears away the idols and holds tight to the Lord when trouble comes: Beau trusts Dad's waiting arms and jumps into the pool even with shaking knees.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because trusting the Lord with your whole heart takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: Beau stands at the edge of the pool, toes curled over the side. Dad is in the water with his arms held out. Beau’s knees shake, but he remembers that Dad has never once let him sink. He takes a big breath and jumps, and Dad catches him. Just like King Hezekiah held tight to the Lord, Beau learned that trusting means jumping toward the One who loves you.
